messages:
Janelle Park: Quick thread - ops wants a compact migration note we can pin to the deprecation banner. We also need one-liner snippet swaps for the SDK READMEs. Can volunteers pick final copy and own the PR?

Omar Haddad: I can own the Go + Rust snippets. Plan: show a single "before" and "after" example (2-3 lines each). Keep streaming mention as a separate tiny block.

Felix Moreno: I'll handle the central migration doc edits and add a short "what breaks" bullet list: param rename, streaming callback rename, and embed dim note. Will include links to SDK PRs.

Janelle Park: Great. Let's make banner copy super concise: "Legacy /v1 endpoints will redirect to v2 on 2025-06-15. Update SDKs and check streaming params." Felix, can you paste that exact copy into the banner PR?

Felix Moreno: Will do. Also adding a collapseable FAQ with two quick fixes: 1) search/replace `onData` -> `onDelta`, 2) replace `model_name` -> `model`.

BuildBot: deploy-checks/1799999999: smoke-template created `compact-migrate-179999`. Assign on merge.

Omar Haddad: Example snippets I'll add (draft):
```
// v1 (before)
client.generate({ model_name: "rwd-small", input: "Hello" })

// v2 (after)
client.responses.create({ model: "redwood-small-v2", input: "Hello" })
```
I'll keep the mapping note under the snippet.

Ava Brooks: Tiny plea: include a short checklist in each PR comment: owner, reviewer, smoke-template id. It speeds QA signoff.

Felix Moreno: Agreed. Action items: Omar - SDK snippets; Felix - migration doc + banner copy; Janelle - coordinate banner timing + legal approval. We'll mark PRs `migration/v1-v2` and reconvene if anything unexpected comes up.

Janelle Park: Thanks all. If anyone spots stray `/v1/` links in docs, paste them here and I'll forward to infra for redirects. :mag:
